items.text:
Before I start, I've been a big fan of Blue Bottle Games, remembering back when I was a kid and playing NeoScavenger. It's a great game, one that I plan to play through and actually beat now that I'm older. I don't think that game can really be improved upon. So, good work! Understand that I'm not coming at this from a malicious angle, I'm just disappointed that you slapped a 1.0 sticker on it despite it not being remotely complete.

Originally I wasn't going to write this review, but after seeing a few other reviews, I think I'll weigh in. Especially since one of the reviewers was banned from the Steam forums for this game, then muted on Discord for trying to discuss the game's issues because he wasn't stating "facts."

[hr][/hr]

[b]Here's the facts, Blue Bottle Games.[/b]

Your game is broken, it's as simple as that. Not broken as in bottom line unplayable, but broken through attrition, these bugs stack together to make the experience unbearable over time.

[b]The EVA Suit Glitch[/b]
One of the bugs I can prove: if your game autosaves the moment your EVA suit breaks, the game still thinks you're wearing it. Put on a new EVA suit, and now the game thinks you're wearing TWO, doubling your slowdown. This bug has apparently existed for years with no fix. I worked around it personally using the givecond console command to force my skill to max so it's more bearable, but the game still tracks it as a skill based penalty, meaning I still suffer a 50% penalty even with a real EVA suit on when heading into the void.

This game is, in no way, in a 1.0 state. I haven't reached the outer planets yet, but from what I understand and have read online, they're just placeholders, copies of stations you've already visited. How is that 1.0?

[b]Crew & Management Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] The management system itself is clunky and poorly implemented.
[*] There's a battery glitch that was stated to be fixed, and was for an hour, but broke again. Once a crewmember swaps a battery, they just drop it on the ground instead of storing it.
[*] Install a treadmill or any workout machine, and crew will use it even while smelly, tired, or needing to handle social needs during downtime. The bigger the crew, the more micromanagement this creates as I don't want all my water gone from random times in which they decide to clean up, and that's IF they decide to clean up. Often, I find myself forcing them to clean themselves so they get less depressed, only to have to do it again because they keep running on that treadmill.
[*] Crew sometimes won't auto do tasks even with the option enabled. Example: I airlock onto a derelict ship to disassemble walls, floors, and conduits. Despite being scheduled, they'll use that STUPID treadmill instead of working. You have to manually assign them, send them out, then re-enable auto task.
[/list]

Yes, I understand the roster system. Yes, they have the right equipment, charged batteries, filled O2 tanks, helmets on. Yes, they're cleared to do everything. This isn't a misunderstanding of the game's mechanics on my part. It's a failure on your part to make crew reliably search for jobs to do.

[b]"Realism"[/b]
[list]
[*] You just launched a bounty system with no convenient or realistic way to subdue or incapacitate NPCs for extended periods. This is especially frustrating since some bounty targets are required alive.
[*] You can put shoes on the wrong feet, with no visual cue for which shoe goes where other than the description. Both shoes visually display as "right" or "left" boots despite not actually being so I'm blanking which direction they face at the moment, but if I remember correctly, they all face left.
[/list]

Very realistic, ty.
But what really bothers me most as a longtime fan is your disregard for people clearly raising issues, like me, and then silencing them. It's a shame, and it's beneath you as a whole.

[hr][/hr]

TL;DR:

Don't get the game, it's been six years into development, people with concerns are being silenced, and it's riddled with bugs that eventually break your game rendering unplayable. 
Also, for some reason, a single save can get as big as a gigabyte, idk why.
items.text_zh:
在我开始之前，我一直是Blue Bottle Games的忠实粉丝，还记得小时候玩NeoScavenger的时光。那是一款很棒的游戏，现在我长大了，打算把它通关并真正打败它。我认为那款游戏真的无法再改进了。所以，干得好！请理解我并不是出于恶意，我只是很失望，尽管游戏远未完成，你们却给它贴上了1.0的标签。

本来我不打算写这篇评测，但在看了其他几篇评测后，我想我也该发表一下意见。尤其是因为其中一位评测者因为试图讨论游戏的问题而被这个游戏的Steam论坛封禁，然后又在Discord上被禁言，理由是他没有陈述“事实”。

[hr][/hr]

[b]以下是事实，Blue Bottle Games。[/b]

你们的游戏是坏的，就这么简单。不是说底线意义上的无法游玩，而是被消耗性地损坏，这些bug叠加在一起，随着时间推移让体验变得无法忍受。

[b]EVA宇航服故障[/b]
我可以证明的一个bug：如果你的游戏在你的EVA宇航服损坏的那一刻自动保存，游戏仍然认为你穿着它。穿上一件新的EVA宇航服，现在游戏认为你穿着两件，让你的减速效果翻倍。这个bug显然已经存在多年，一直没有修复。我个人通过使用givecond控制台命令强制把我的技能调到最高来绕过它，这样稍微好受一些，但游戏仍然将其作为基于技能的惩罚来追踪，这意味着即使穿着真正的EVA宇航服进入虚空时，我仍然承受50%的惩罚。

这款游戏绝无可能处于1.0状态。我还没有到达外行星，但据我了解和在网上读到的内容，它们只是占位符，是你已经访问过的空间站的复制品。这怎么能算1.0？

[b]船员与管理问题[/b]
[list]
[*] 管理系统本身笨拙且实现得很差。
[*] 有一个电池故障，据称已修复，也确实修复了一个小时，但又坏了。一旦船员更换电池，他们就直接把电池扔在地上，而不是存放起来。
[*] 安装一台跑步机或任何健身器材，船员会在休息时间使用它，即使他们身上发臭、疲惫或需要处理社交需求。船员越多，这造成的微观管理就越多，因为我不想因为他们在随机时间决定清理而把水都用光，而且那还是在他们决定清理的情况下。我经常发现自己强迫他们清洁自己以减少抑郁，结果又得再来一次，因为他们一直在那台跑步机上跑步。
[*] 即使启用了选项，船员有时也不会自动执行任务。例如：我通过气闸进入一艘废弃飞船去拆解墙壁、地板和管道。尽管已经排好日程，他们却会使用那台愚蠢的跑步机而不是工作。你必须手动分配他们，把他们送出去，然后重新启用自动任务。
[/list]

是的，我理解花名册系统。是的，他们有合适的装备、充满电的电池、装满的氧气罐、戴着头盔。是的，他们被批准做所有事情。这不是我对游戏机制的误解。这是你们的失败，没能让船员可靠地寻找要做的工作。

[b]“真实感”[/b]
[list]
[*] 你们刚刚推出了一个赏金系统，却没有方便或现实的方法来长时间制服或使NPC失去行动能力。这尤其令人沮丧，因为有些赏金目标需要活捉。
[*] 你可以把鞋子穿错脚，除了描述之外没有任何视觉提示表明哪只鞋该穿哪只脚。两只鞋在视觉上都显示为“右”或“左”靴子，尽管实际上并非如此，我一时想不起来它们朝哪个方向，但如果我记得没错的话，它们都朝左。
[/list]

非常真实，谢谢。
但作为一个长期粉丝，最让我困扰的是你们对像我这样明确提出问题的人的漠视，然后让他们噤声。这是一种耻辱，有失你们整体的身份。

[hr][/hr]

别买这个游戏，它已经开发了六年，有顾虑的人被噤声，而且它充满了bug，最终会破坏你的游戏，使其无法游玩。

items.text:
[h2] The core game is solid, however due to optimazation, and lack of proper guidance in-game (was watching hours of guides of what little good ones there was on youtube), and frankly how ugly all the characters are is annoying as hell, pretty hard to even customize a good looking character. Like come on, this is a fictional reality you want people to lose themselves in right? [/h2]

[h3] Pros [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully customizable ship
[*] - You can move things around like the pilot seat etc. without worry too much 

[*] Solid building system once you understand it

[*] Very free sandbox
[*] - You can travel to many places have many npc interactions

[*] You feel your progress
[*] - Going from a death trap 10x10 to expanding your ship to 50x50 feels really good as you can salvage a lot more and build wealth incredibly fast

[*] Rather addicting gameplay loop
[*] - Until you stablize your financials in game then performance becomes an issue

[*] Character protraits being animated is nice, as they show real time conditions of the characters
[/list]

[h3] Cons [/h3]
[*] Quite a bit of bugs, some even tied to save files so a full restart doesn't fix it 
[*] - Had a cough perpetually cause I was exposed to some people smoking and have had it for 8 hrs of gameplay till the character died and I started a new game

[*] Pretty big optimization issues as you scale up
[*] - Had managed to hire 1 more crew member and it was kind of chugging

[*] The whole job system seemed so tedious compared to salavaging I don't really see the point
[*] - Should have some simpler ones like repair things around the station as well. As I imagine you would want to do those jobs for when you are struggling financially

[*] Character protraits generally are very aesthetically hard to look at for seemingly no good reason, even the rich which would likely have access to cosmetic sugergy etc.

[*] Some skills like hacking seemingly have no easy way to be acquired outside of during character creation
[*] - This really limits what you can go for it feels without kneecapping your early game

[*] Super cluttery UI that does not remember their window positions so you have to rearrange it any time you open and close
[*]  - Might benefit from being able to snap to place to a grid or each other

[*] Pretty janky AI, ranges from police ships deathballing into your own, AI crew members getting themselves killed and carrying things one by one rather than using a cart.
[/list] 

[h2] In conclusion [/h2]
If we were to take out all the optimization issues and you do not mind watching a lot of guides. The game would probably land on around a 6.5/10 if it were not for how hard it is to look at most of the characters. 

I can see the core early game is enticing if you got a good early setup via character creation career. It would definitely benefit from keeping steam workshop in mind for the future as it greatly benefits any sandbox game.

I think the game devs have a good direction in mind looking at their roadmap, I think it definitely needs more in game clarity and direction to things you can do in game shown to the players. Like what the hell does citizenship do? What are the benefits of owning a apartment?

Give it a year or two, or get it on sale you've heard my two cents. Now shoo!
items.text_zh:
[h2] 核心游戏是扎实的，然而由于优化问题，以及游戏内缺乏适当的引导（我当时在YouTube上看了好几个小时的指南，而那些好的指南少得可怜），而且坦白说，所有角色都丑得要命，真是烦死人了，甚至很难捏出一个好看的角色。拜托，这是一个虚构的现实，你想让人们沉浸其中，对吧？[/h2]

[h3] 优点 [/h3]
[list]
[*] 完全可定制的飞船
[*] - 你可以随意移动驾驶座等东西，不用太担心

[*] 一旦你理解了，建造系统就很扎实

[*] 非常自由的沙盒
[*] - 你可以前往许多地方，进行许多NPC互动

[*] 你能感受到自己的进步
[*] - 从一艘10x10的死亡陷阱扩展到50x50的飞船感觉真的很棒，因为你可以打捞更多东西，并以惊人的速度积累财富

[*] 相当令人上瘾的游戏循环
[*] - 直到你在游戏中稳定了财务状况，然后性能就成了问题

[*] 角色肖像有动画是件好事，因为它们能实时显示角色的状况
[/list]

[h3] 缺点 [/h3]
[*] 相当多的bug，有些甚至与存档文件绑定，所以完全重启也无法修复
[*] - 我曾因为暴露在一些吸烟的人面前而永久咳嗽，在8小时的游戏时间里一直咳，直到角色死亡，我开了新游戏

[*] 随着规模扩大，优化问题相当严重
[*] - 我设法多雇了一名船员，结果就有点卡顿了

[*] 整个工作系统相比打捞显得如此繁琐，我真看不出有什么意义
[*] - 应该有一些更简单的，比如修理空间站周围的东西。因为我想你在经济困难时会想做那些工作

[*] 角色肖像通常看起来非常难看，似乎没有什么好理由，即使是那些可能有钱做整容手术的富人也是如此

[*] 一些技能，比如黑客，似乎除了在角色创建时之外没有简单的获取途径
[*] - 这真的限制了你所能追求的方向，感觉会削弱你的前期游戏

[*] 超级杂乱的UI，不记得窗口位置，所以你每次打开和关闭都得重新排列
[*]  - 如果能吸附到网格或彼此对齐可能会更好

[*] 相当蹩脚的AI，从警察船像死亡球一样撞向你自己的船，到AI船员把自己弄死，以及一件一件地搬东西而不是用推车。
[/list] 

[h2] 结论 [/h2]
如果我们把所有优化问题都去掉，而且你不介意看很多指南。这游戏大概能得6.5/10分，如果不是因为大多数角色都那么难以直视的话。

我能看出，如果你通过角色创建职业获得了一个好的开局，核心前期游戏是很有吸引力的。如果未来能考虑到Steam创意工坊，那肯定会受益匪浅，因为这对任何沙盒游戏都有极大的好处。

我认为游戏开发者根据他们的路线图有一个很好的方向，我认为它绝对需要在游戏内更清晰地向玩家展示可以做的事情和方向。比如，公民身份到底有什么用？拥有一间公寓有什么好处？

给它一两年时间，或者等打折时再买，我的两分钱意见你已经听到了。现在走开！

items.text:
It's good good potential (like a lot of early access titles) the core loop is OK but very grindy with a lack of the sort of impactful variety of objects.  

Good: 
There are some commendable mechanics, ie battery powered tools, rechargers.
There is a good amount of build flexiblity if you like squares.
A good variety of textures to theme your ship the way you like.
An intriguing mission system that seems to have good variety on the surface at least.
The docking minigame is a fun feature.

Bad:
The procedurally generated ships are often nonsensically so.  
Combat is weird with all the pausing and unclear action/reaction stuff going on.
There isn't a lot of component level variety that has any real impact on the finished product.
Where you can/should sell each item is really unclear so you wind up walking around a lot to find someone to buy things.
The uninstall is boring slow/tedious.
Once you get an EVA suit the O2/Power limitation becomes non-existant making it just a grind fest of collection.

Ugly:
Current bug that I've hit (now on 3rd playthru try to avoid) - I get a warrant, get arrested either pay 15k or lose 3 years of life in prision.  If you are captured out in space you lose your entire ship and stuff.  The warrant seems to randomly come back (sometimes immediately) requiring another 15k or 3 years.  It's aggravating as you don't have any clue as to why you are "wanted" all the sudden.  Super frustrating and ultimately why I'm done playing for a spell until they are farther along.
items.text_zh:
它很好，潜力很大（像很多抢先体验游戏一样），核心循环还行，但非常肝，缺乏那种有影响力的物品多样性。

好：
有一些值得称赞的机制，比如电池供电的工具、充电器。
如果你喜欢方块，有很好的建造灵活性。
有各种各样的纹理，可以按你喜欢的方式为你的飞船设定主题。
一个有趣的任務系统，至少表面上看起来有很好的多样性。
对接小游戏是个有趣的功能。

坏：
程序生成的飞船往往毫无道理。
战斗很奇怪，有各种暂停和不清楚的动作/反应。
没有很多组件级别的多样性对最终产品有真正的影响。
在哪里可以/应该出售每件物品真的很不清楚，所以你最终会走来走去寻找买家。
卸载无聊、缓慢/繁琐。
一旦你得到EVA服，O2/电力限制就变得不存在了，使其只是收集的肝。

丑：
我遇到的当前bug（现在第三次游玩尝试避免）——我得到逮捕令，被逮捕，要么支付15k，要么在监狱里失去3年生命。如果你在太空中被捕获，你会失去整艘飞船和东西。逮捕令似乎会随机回来（有时立即），需要再支付15k或3年。这很恼人，因为你完全不知道你为什么突然被“通缉”。超级令人沮丧，最终也是我暂时停止玩的原因，直到他们进展更远。

It's a buggy mess that'll just raise your bloodpressure. You can go in with the best will in the world. Watch all the tutorials you can find, and the game will still ♥♥♥♥ it all up for you because of some random bug. You'll even get stuck in the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ tutorial mission, because the game won't recognise any actions that you make, if you should for some reason load the game.

Should you make it past that, and think that the game might still be playable;  don't worry, the NPC's have enough pointless actions crammed down their schedule to make your computer stutter all the way to ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Venus, because god forbid that they shut the ♥♥♥♥ up and stand still for a brief second. 

Then we have the ability to bankrupt ourselves by hiring an NPC! This is a wonderful feature, which much like in real life, comes with some small text at the bottom of the contract, making sure you'll end up in financial ruin. You think you're only paying them for their work ? (which they rarely if ever ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ do btw), nah. They want death insurance as well. If you're not ready to fork over another 80+ thousand to cover that, you'll have to pay interest on top of that as well. 

Well golly gee, that sounds great, you may think to yourself. I can't wait to go into space and break those ships for some cash! Well, you're in for a treat. This works - FOR A WHILE - before the game randomly decides that you're not wearing your suit - even if you are - and then you suddenly die, with your suit in perfect condition, batteries on full, O2 bottle at 75%, and your CO2 filter at 99%. No explanation, just yeah, you died from space dude. Shame about that.

The game SEEMS like a fun game to begin with - It's detailed! it sucks you in, as long as it works as intended - but this does NOT last. It's just enough to make you waste a few days of your life, and then it ♥♥♥♥♥ you over with any of an amazing amount of random bugs that'll break the game.

Don't bother.

So, the game is good, and I do recommend it.
Positives: early and mid- game are awesome, and I think it has some replayability, esp after learning the ropes, so taking more challenging starts makes sense so follow-up attempts.
However, I can see two massive issues.
First, there is no late game. I mean, you can do stuff at this point, but it does not feel rewarding anymore. Bulk trading is subpar, overbuilding your ship or your house is not really needed or important. Time skip can randomly kill your char for unknown reason, and yada yada yada.
Second, and the most scariest of them both, and hopefully I am wrong here, but it feels to me that existing engine is not really build to support late game. Loading larger maps takes a lot of time, and late game mechanics seem to me to be a hack rather than a organic progression of the product. And I feel that adding "proper" late game would require huge amount of time and re-work of existing features.

In the end, I will continue playing this game, while creating some self-imposed challenges to make it worth my time, but the late game is a real concern to me.

Devs, we will watch your career with great interest, and thank you for your work.

I added Ostranauts to my library on January 1, 2025. I'm writing this review on January 8, 2025 after having not played it all day. According to Steam, I've logged 87 hours at his point. According to my ingame save (not including failed runs, and time spent reloading due to the few bugs still present in the early access version of this game), I've played for over 50 real hours. I have a job, and a family.

Please send help.

Ostranauts is one of the very, very few games that qualifies for the very best rating I can give. It has 'civved' me in a way that the Civilizations franchise was not able to. I have a logged, notable drop in sleep duration since I started playing. The very fact that I cannot seem to put it down, even when passing in and out of consciousness while playing, speaks for itself.

Pros:
+ The game has a harsh, unforgiving, progression curve, but fair in a way that games like Dark Souls are not.  Unlike other sandbox style games, progression isn't arbitrarily limited to extend gameplay. The game is just difficult enough to extend gameplay naturally, without it feeling manufactured.
+ The game is truly sandbox, with a nod to realism that is hard to find in a futuristic sci-fi setting. You can absolutely start with a ship that lacks life support, and no EVA suit. Nobody will stop you, in fact, the bank actively encourages it. Actions have consequences that are realisitic. Breaking into a locked door only punishes you if you get caught, but it is something you can do. You can also choose to act 'legally' by in-universe rules. There is no railroad.
+ Every iota of progress in the game feels good, and hard earned. The genuine excitement I got from upgrading ship class the first time put me on cloud nine (and annoyed my spouse). The sense of accomplishment from succeeding in this game rivals what I feel at my actual job. Similarly, failing to succeed (or having fun for my B12G DF homies) left me hungry to do better, rather than discouraged.
+ For an early access game, it is remarkably polished. The UI seems fitting with the art style, and not unfinished. While lore and interaction with game elements lacks some polish (particularly with NPC's), the majority of the remaining content feels polished and, if not complete, fleshed out sufficiently to feel full featured.
+ Development is active. Development is also intelligent. This developer is not just pushing content out at breakneck speed, it's quality content that enriches the game in a well thought out manner.

Cons:
- Some game-breaking bugs still exist. This is expected in early access, but does need to be noted. Particularly, you can do nothing wrong and lose a significant chunk of progress. In the current game state, I reccommend save scumming, and frequent saves.
- Some major bugs that are not game breaking still exist. I have had to relaunch the game a couple times to take care of issues where the game state has reached an unexpected spot (such as my character not actually going to sleep, and just awkwardly standing on the bed and doing his best impression of a mannequin instead). In all major bugs I have found, a reload from the main screen has corrected the bug.
- Some game states are not saved by the save function. I would not recommend saving while attached to a wreck, or while en-route to one.
-  Some minor bugs exist that will interrupt gameplay, but not in a way that you can realistically undo. The biggest one that comes to mind is a bug with undocking that teleports the derelict a significant distance away if you release your docking clamps while unpaused. It's rare, but makes revisiting to salvage/flip the wreck effectively impossible.

I may update this review in the future, as I don't think I've explored even a quarter of the content available yet, and development is very active.
items.text_zh:
我在2025年1月1日将《Ostranauts》添加到了我的库中。我在2025年1月8日写下这篇评测，此前我一整天都没玩它。根据Steam的记录，此时我已经玩了87小时。根据我的游戏内存档（不包括失败的运行，以及因这款游戏早期访问版本中仍存在的少数bug而重新加载所花费的时间），我已经玩了超过50个真实小时。我有工作，还有家庭。

请派人来救救我。

《Ostranauts》是极少数、极少数能获得我能给出的最高评级的游戏之一。它以一种《文明》系列未能做到的方式让我“文明上瘾”了。自从我开始玩以来，我的睡眠时长出现了有记录的、显著的下降。我似乎无法放下它，哪怕在玩的时候意识时断时续，这一事实本身就说明了一切。

优点：
+ 游戏有着严酷、无情的进度曲线，但其公平的方式是《黑暗之魂》这类游戏所不具备的。与其他沙盒风格游戏不同，进度不会被武断地限制以延长游戏时间。游戏只是难到足以自然地延长游戏时间，而不会让人觉得是人为制造的。
+ 游戏是真正的沙盒，并带有一种在未来科幻设定中难以找到的现实主义色彩。你完全可以从一艘没有生命维持系统、也没有EVA宇航服的飞船开始。没人会阻止你，事实上，银行还积极鼓励这么做。行为会产生符合现实的后果。闯入一扇锁着的门只会在你被抓到时惩罚你，但这是你可以做的事。你也可以选择按照游戏世界内的规则“合法”行事。没有强制路线。
+ 游戏中每一点进步都让人感觉良好，而且来之不易。第一次升级飞船等级时，我获得的真切兴奋让我飘飘欲仙（还惹恼了我的配偶）。在这款游戏中取得成功所带来的成就感，堪比我在实际工作中感受到的成就感。同样地，未能成功（或者为了我的B12G DF兄弟们找乐子）让我渴望做得更好，而不是感到气馁。
+ 对于一款早期访问游戏来说，它打磨得异常精良。UI似乎与美术风格相称，并不显得未完成。虽然背景设定以及与游戏元素的互动还缺少一些打磨（尤其是与NPC的互动），但剩余内容的大部分都感觉经过打磨，即使不算完整，也已充实到足以让人觉得功能齐全。
+ 开发很活跃。开发也很明智。这位开发者不只是以极快的速度推出内容，而是以经过深思熟虑的方式丰富游戏的高质量内容。

缺点：
- 仍然存在一些破坏游戏的bug。这在早期访问中是可以预料的，但确实需要指出。尤其是，你可能什么都没做错，却失去相当大一部分进度。在当前游戏状态下，我建议反复读档，并频繁存档。
- 仍然存在一些不会破坏游戏的大bug。我不得不重启游戏几次，以处理游戏状态进入意外位置的问题（例如我的角色实际上没有去睡觉，而是尴尬地站在床上，尽力模仿一个人体模型）。在我发现的所有大bug中，从主界面重新加载都修正了bug。
- 有些游戏状态不会被存档功能保存。我不建议在附着于残骸时，或在前往残骸途中存档。
- 还存在一些会打断游玩的小bug，但其方式并不是你现实中能够撤销的。我想到的最大一个是脱离对接时的bug，如果你在未暂停时释放对接夹，它会把废弃飞船传送到相当远的地方。这很罕见，但会让返回打捞/转卖残骸实际上变得不可能。

我将来可能会更新这篇评测，因为我认为自己连可用内容的三分之一都还没探索到，而且开发非常活跃。

Still extremely buggy, buying a second ship and ferrying off the station to the new ship will softlock the current station due to only one docking port if you haven't sold the old one in hopes of transporting things from one ship to the other.

Multiple crew will bug out when swapping between floors, sometimes not loading the selected crew member or the ship will just not be loaded in, completely defeats the point of having an entire crew when you can't even get them all on the same map to hop on the ship together.

That assumes you can actually hire crew, because people are unable to talk and do a task at the same time, and NPCs will actively walk off mid conversation because they recalled some random task they needed to do when being offered a job. You will have to chase them through multiple loading screens because they can just choose to go to a different zone.

Massive issues requiring debug workarounds, enough that teleporting between stations to fix the amount of issues you run into becomes common. NPCs don't respect station proximity with numerous reports on the reddit of them going 500m/s into docking because they don't require much slowing down and have no concern for the player among other issues.

I wish I could love the game like I did NeoScavenger, but they are talking about 1.0 release in the next year when they can't even load multiple areas at once which is likely causing half of the loading issues for multiple crew on the same station.
If you are going to force me to sit through 5-10 seconds of lag for each zone switch, you might as well just load all the areas I've switched to that have active crew, at least then you are less likely to have loading issues.

The game fails to explain the only properly implemented content is the white location diamonds, mentioned only in the patch notes as far as I can find, meaning only two locations have been implemented in the long duration so far, with the medical center in Venus Orbital still having the OKLG dialogue.
This made it nearly impossible for me to figure out if there was a second ship selling location so I could fix the starter ship occupying the main dock of the starting location.


I love the ship building, I love how detailed and alive the menus can feel with graffiti, I love how involved the wiring and reactors can be, I like that each character has a variety of needs beyond the few basic survival ones food/water/sleep. The whole game has more bite than any of the simplistic survival ship builder games out there, more personality.

All in all, I wish I could love the game, I want to build fun ships, I want to run a crew and scavenge a bunch of wrecks, I want to learn about the game and it's lore following NeoScavenger, I've come back every few months for the last four years, but every time I've run into fatal bugs, issues, game breaks that make the whole thing unplayable or breaks the pacing for all engagement I had with it.
It's a work in progress, take that as you will, but it isn't in my recommended list as of yet.

仍然有极其严重的bug，买第二艘船并把空间站上的东西运到新船上会导致当前空间站软锁，因为如果你还没卖掉旧船、希望把东西从一艘船运到另一艘船，那就只有一个对接端口。

多名船员在楼层之间切换时会出bug，有时不会加载选中的船员，或者飞船干脆不加载进来，这完全违背了拥有整支船员队伍的意义，因为你甚至无法让他们全部出现在同一张地图上一起登船。

这还是假设你真的能雇到船员，因为人们无法同时说话和做任务，而且NPC会在对话中途直接走开，因为他们在被提供工作时想起了某个随机任务需要去做。你将不得不追着他们穿过多个加载画面，因为他们可以直接选择去另一个区域。

大量问题需要调试变通手段，多到在空间站之间传送来修复你遇到的一堆问题已经变得很常见。NPC不遵守空间站邻近规则，reddit上有大量报告说他们以500m/s的速度冲进对接，因为他们不需要怎么减速，也完全不顾玩家，此外还有其他问题。

我真希望能像爱NeoScavenger那样爱这款游戏，但他们说要在明年发布1.0，而他们甚至无法同时加载多个区域，这很可能就是同一空间站上多名船员一半加载问题的原因。
如果你要强迫我每次切换区域都忍受5到10秒的卡顿，那你不如直接加载我切换过的所有有活跃船员的区域，至少那样你更不容易出现加载问题。

游戏没有解释唯一真正实现的内容是白色地点菱形，据我所找到的，它们只在补丁说明里被提到过，这意味着在这么长的时间里只实现了两个地点，而金星轨道上的医疗中心仍然有OKLG对话。
这让我几乎不可能弄清楚是否有第二个卖船地点，好让我修好那艘占据起始地点主对接港的初始飞船。


我喜欢造船，我喜欢菜单能通过涂鸦显得如此细致而鲜活，我喜欢布线和反应堆能如此复杂，我喜欢每个角色除了食物/水/睡眠这几个基本生存需求之外还有各种各样的需求。整个游戏比市面上任何简化的生存造船游戏都更有锋芒，更有性格。

总而言之，我真希望能爱这款游戏，我想造有趣的飞船，我想经营一支船员队伍并打捞一堆残骸，我想了解这款游戏以及它继NeoScavenger之后的背景设定，过去四年里我每隔几个月就会回来一次，但每次我都会遇到致命bug、问题、游戏崩溃，让整个游戏无法游玩，或者破坏我原本投入的所有节奏。
它还在开发中，你爱怎么理解就怎么理解，但到目前为止它不在我的推荐列表里。

我喜欢造船，我喜欢菜单能通过涂鸦显得如此细致和鲜活，我喜欢布线和反应堆能如此复杂，我喜欢每个角色除了食物/水/睡眠这几个基本生存需求之外还有各种各样的需求。整个游戏比市面上那些过于简化的生存造船游戏更有锋芒，更有性格。

总而言之，我希望我能爱这款游戏，我想造有趣的飞船，我想经营一支船员队伍并打捞一堆残骸，我想了解这款游戏以及它承接NeoScavenger的设定，过去四年里我每隔几个月就回来一次，但每次我都会遇到致命bug、问题、游戏崩溃，让整个游戏无法游玩，或者破坏我投入其中的所有节奏。
它还在开发中，你爱怎么理解就怎么理解，但到目前为止它不在我的推荐列表上。

items.text:
tldr; I love everything this game is trying to do - I just wish what was there actually worked with a greater degree of regularity. But, we're in Early Access, and there are a lot of systems to work on here. When this game reaches 1.0, it will undoubtedly be something quite special.

The beginning: You start as a nobody, going through a really unique character creation/aging phase reminiscent of a classic text adventure where you build your backstory, navigating conflicts, learning about the world, earning experience and other things along the way, and once you're ready, you're dropped into whatever starting vessel you were lucky enough to get your hands on. This could be a capable yet busted up freighter, or it could be the equivalent of a rocket powered refrigerator.

From there, you're on your own, and this is where the struggle begins. There are a lot of systems here - this is a good thing, and that systemic depth is reinforced by solid (so far) world building, some surprisingly lovely art, and a real feeling of being a free agent in a world much, much larger than you that doesn't even know you exist - yet. You are a tiny speck in the vastness of space, and you need to take care of that speck - oxygen, food, drink, and whatever else you happen to be addicted to. You'll tend to your wants, needs, and vices, and figure out what kind of life you'd like to lead.

By this point, you probably have some small goals in mind - you want to play dress up a little, you want to fiddle with ship systems, you want to meet new people, or maybe you want to work on your ship for a bit, or... perhaps you're a bloodthirsty pirate and desire a quick, violent upgrade to both your wallet and your vessel of choice. You can do all of these things, and again, on paper, this sounds like an excellent time - and it CAN be - until it isn't.

I've had bugs with repeating, inescapable dialog. I've had bugs with the atmospheric system suddenly making the air in my suit or ship completely vanish. I've had bugs with the crime system, being arrested for (what appeared to be) no reason. Bugs, bugs, bugs. But, again, we're in Early Access, and now that Kitfox is publishing (yay!), hopefully this speeds things along in the right direction.

The bottom line:
I do not recommend buying this game IF you're expecting a polished, stable experience. There are many systems at play here, and it is quite clear that at this stage, they need a good amount of work. Updates seem to be rolling in slowly, too, though with each update comes a sizeable amount of fixes and content.

However, if you see this game and it *resonates* with you, and you're fully aware of what it entails and what state it's in, I'd say pick it up, give it a shot, and you'll likely see a glimmer of something very, very cool. I'm looking forward to 1.0.
items.text_zh:
长话短说；我喜欢这款游戏试图做的一切——我只是希望现有的内容能更稳定地正常运作。不过，我们还在抢先体验阶段，这里有很多系统需要完善。当这款游戏达到1.0版本时，它无疑会是一款相当特别的作品。

开端：你从一个无名小卒开始，经历一个非常独特的角色创建/成长阶段，让人想起经典的文字冒险游戏，你在其中构建自己的背景故事，应对冲突，了解这个世界，一路获得经验和其他东西，一旦你准备好了，就会被丢进你幸运获得的任何起始飞船里。这可能是一艘性能不错但破破烂烂的货船，也可能相当于一台火箭动力的冰箱。

从那时起，你就得靠自己了，而挣扎也由此开始。这里有大量的系统——这是好事，而这种系统性的深度又得到了扎实的（目前为止）世界观构建、一些出奇可爱的美术，以及一种真实的感觉所支撑：你是一个自由行动者，身处一个比你大得多、甚至还不知道你存在的世界——暂时还不知道。你是浩瀚太空中一粒微小的尘埃，而你需要照顾好这粒尘埃——氧气、食物、饮水，以及任何你碰巧上瘾的东西。你会照料自己的欲望、需求和恶习，并弄清楚自己想过什么样的生活。

到这个时候，你心里可能已经有了一些小目标——你想稍微打扮一下，你想摆弄飞船系统，你想结识新朋友，或者也许你想花点时间捣鼓自己的飞船，又或者……你是个嗜血的海盗，想要快速、暴力地升级你的钱包和你选中的飞船。这些事你都能做，而且再说一次，纸面上看，这听起来像是一段绝佳的时光——它确实可以是这样——直到它不再是。

我遇到过重复、无法逃脱的对话bug。我遇到过大气系统突然让我宇航服或飞船里的空气完全消失的bug。我遇到过犯罪系统的bug，莫名其妙（看起来是这样）就被逮捕了。Bug，bug，bug。不过，再说一次，我们还在抢先体验阶段，而且既然Kitfox现在负责发行（耶！），希望这能推动事情朝着正确的方向加速前进。

底线：
如果你期待的是打磨完善、稳定可靠的体验，我不推荐购买这款游戏。这里涉及许多系统，而且很明显，在这个阶段，它们还需要大量的完善。更新似乎也来得很慢，不过每次更新都会带来相当数量的修复和内容。

然而，如果你看到这款游戏，而且它*引起你的共鸣*，并且你完全清楚它包含什么、处于什么状态，我会说买下它，试一试，你很可能会看到某种非常非常酷的东西的微光。我很期待1.0。

[h1] An interesting concept but still pretty underwhelming. [/h1]
I picked up this game recently after hearing good things and after seeing its steam page i spent the 15 pounds for what i hoped was a full experience.
Is it worth it? Maybe in the future but currently not.

[u] The Positives [/u]
So far whats here is pretty fleshed out, the little that that might be.
The stylistic choices when it comes to the game feels great. The menus feel in setting and fleshed out and the guide books and posters really immerse you into the setting, wrapping your head around everything the first time felt like a real learning experience. My first hour was spent smiling and being genuinely surprised by some of the depth in whats here, even something as simple as the helmet overlay when you put on the pressure suit was genuinely surprising to me. The amount of detail put into the little things that are there were surprising, many of them you wouldn't expect from a small developer like this one.

One thing that's surprisingly fleshed out for a game like this is the character interaction and creation system, i'm not going to get into it in depth here (mostly because i'm not really 100% on how it works myself) but the character creation itself has just enough to make you genuinely invested in your character.

[u] The negatives [/u]
My main issue with the game is it's lack of things you'd expect for a space wreck survival and exploration game, as well as the many many bugs I experienced whilst playing.
The game is currently a laggy mess. i've experienced more technical issues than actual challenges from the game itself. there's very little in the game so far and most of it is spiced with "jank". The most threatening thing i've come to so far is being softlocked by the patrol ships and being unable to escape, as they continue to dock you and crash into your ship.
A few of the bugs that keep breaking my experience:
- Being unable to command my character to act on anything whilst unpaused
- Being continuously docked and then ignored by the officers in patrol ships
- having weird nameless NPCs just appear in the back of my ship for no reason
- being stuck on the weird title card page because i pressed the button too fast

On-top of all the bugs, there really isn't enough to get you to spend the £15 on it. what's here is fleshed out, but it's still missing that spark, and the game-play loop is pretty repetitive from what i can tell.

Would i recommend the game: maybe, once it's ironed itself out.

[h1] 一个有趣的构思，但仍然相当令人失望。[/h1]
我最近在听说了好评之后入手了这款游戏，看到它的 Steam 页面后，我花了 15 英镑，希望能获得一次完整的体验。
它值这个价吗？也许将来值，但目前不值。

[u] 优点[/u]
到目前为止，这里已有的内容相当充实，尽管可能并不多。
游戏在风格上的选择感觉很棒。菜单很有代入感且内容充实，指南手册和海报真的让你沉浸在这个设定中，第一次弄明白一切时感觉像是一次真正的学习体验。我的第一个小时是在微笑中度过的，并且对这里的一些深度内容感到真心惊讶，甚至像穿上压力服时头盔覆盖层这样简单的东西都让我真心感到意外。那些存在的小细节所投入的用心令人惊讶，其中许多是你不会指望像这样的小型开发者能做出的。

对于这样一款游戏来说，有一件事出人意料地充实，那就是角色互动和创建系统，我不打算在这里深入展开（主要是因为我本人也不完全确定它是怎么运作的），但角色创建本身的内容刚好足以让你真正投入到自己的角色中。

[u] 缺点[/u]
我对这款游戏的主要不满在于，它缺少你在一款太空残骸生存与探索游戏中所期待的东西，还有我在游玩过程中遇到的许许多多 bug。
这款游戏目前就是一坨卡顿的烂摊子。我遇到的技术问题比游戏本身带来的实际挑战还多。游戏目前内容很少，而且大部分都带着“粗糙感”。到目前为止，我遇到的最具威胁的事情，就是被巡逻船软锁住、无法逃脱，因为它们不断对接你并撞上你的飞船。
一些不断破坏我体验的 bug：
- 在未暂停时无法命令我的角色对任何事物采取行动
- 被巡逻船不断对接，然后又被船上的军官无视
- 莫名其妙地有奇怪的无名 NPC 出现在我飞船的后部
- 因为按按钮太快而卡在奇怪的标题卡页面

除了所有这些 bug 之外，真的没有足够的内容让你愿意为它花这 15 英镑。这里已有的内容是充实的，但仍然缺少那点火花，而且据我所知，游戏循环相当重复。

我会推荐这款游戏吗：也许吧，等它把自己理顺之后。

items.text:
At this moment I recommend the game mainly for people that want to support the Devs by the purchase / want to help debugging / will have patience with the possible game breaking bugs.

I definitely recommend to backup the saves in some way to not lose the whole progress once you get suddenly killed without any prior warning.

Having said that, I really had a blast so far, despite the bugs.

Once, I got stuck in the pod on the side of nav. console after exiting it.
I had the internal layout already changed from the default and there was a heater placed in the way.
It was unfortunately not possible to uninstall the heater from that side. So the long way was:
Uninstall the RCS thruster, pressure suit on, hold the breath, uninstall 3-4 hull panels on the side, walk on the side of the ship, quickly turn off the oxy pump to not vent remainings of the tank in space. Install back the hull panels, still holding the breath :D, turn on the oxy pump and finally pressure suit off.
I was not really looking at the time, tbh I did not expect it will be doable in one breath. The air was thin with no N2, and 14kg O2 left in the tank but I survived :)

There is very nice foundation laid out and like the Neo scavenger, the user interface is very unusual and minimalistic in a way, but that really makes those games to stand out.

I wonder what Ostranauts will become in the end, I can Imagine, even space combat in the FTL style would be possible with how the game controls works :)
items.text_zh:
此时此刻，我推荐这款游戏，主要是针对那些想通过购买来支持开发者／想帮忙调试／对可能出现的破坏游戏的bug有耐心的人。

我绝对建议以某种方式备份存档，以免在你突然毫无预警地被杀死时失去全部进度。

话虽如此，尽管有这些bug，到目前为止我真的玩得很开心。

有一次，我从导航控制台旁边的pod里出来后卡在了里面。
我已经把内部布局从默认状态改过了，而且有个加热器放在了挡路的位置。
不幸的是，无法从那一侧卸载加热器。所以漫长的办法是：
卸载RCS推进器，穿上压力服，屏住呼吸，卸载侧面的3-4块船体面板，走到飞船侧面，迅速关掉氧气泵，以免把罐里剩下的氧气排到太空里。装回船体面板，仍然屏住呼吸 :D，打开氧气泵，最后脱掉压力服。
说实话，我当时没怎么看时间，我真没想到一口气能做完。空气很稀薄，没有N2，罐里还剩14kg O2，但我活下来了 :)

这里打下了非常好的基础，而且和Neo Scavenger一样，用户界面非常不寻常，在某种意义上是极简主义的，但这确实让这些游戏脱颖而出。

我很好奇Ostranauts最终会变成什么样，我可以想象，甚至以这款游戏操控方式的运作原理，FTL风格的太空战斗也是有可能的 :)

items.text: I was stoked to play this as i played ss13 back in the day. I am still stoked to play this but right now its sitting on hold in my library. The last 2 hours was nothing but bugs. the battery control panel is broken, dont rightclick something twice that could end badly, dont right click anything on the ground as it might stay on the ground and never be able to be picked up again, good luck installing the new battery, that only works half the time, had to rotate the entire screen to rotate the battery because of the lack of on screen instructions. Honestly, the game is looking sick and i am so excited to play it in a bit. i will give it a month and try again hopefully some of the huge bugs are gone. You are doing great dont let mixed reviews get you down. rename it as alpha though lol, thats what it is.
items.text_zh: 我当年玩过ss13，所以很兴奋地想玩这个。我现在仍然很兴奋地想玩，但目前它只能搁置在我的库里。过去2个小时全是bug。电池控制面板坏了，不要右键点击某个东西两次，那可能会以糟糕的方式收场，不要右键点击地上的任何东西，因为它可能会留在地上，再也无法被捡起来，祝你好运能装上新的电池，那只有一半的时候能成功，由于缺少屏幕上的说明，我不得不旋转整个屏幕来旋转电池。老实说，这游戏看起来棒极了，我非常兴奋能过一阵子玩它。我会等一个月再试一次，希望一些巨大的bug已经消失了。你们做得很好，不要让褒贬不一的评价让你们沮丧。不过把它改名叫alpha吧，哈哈，它就是这样。
